checks.detail: Source-map S01–S31 accurately trace browser branches, verified webhook dispatch, official finalizer, effect hooks and native transaction completion limitations. Independently checked all 52 source-file hashes, six candidate-file hashes and 44 normalized anchor hashes without mismatch.

Reconciliation-design §3 separates read-only R, server-admitted C and explicit P. Exact ownership/snapshot/store/channel binding, private capabilities, CSRF controls, holds and shared provider-call accounting remain requirements; no new access authority is granted.

Sections 4–5 distinguish known failures and actionable customer intervention from financial uncertainty. They reject compulsory identical retries, invented support capabilities and unimplemented persistence, notification or background-progress promises.

Sections 2, 6–7 and the source map cover shop/recovery callers, current-cart hook and no-cart direct official confirmation, restoration/redirect, signed webhook, explicit operations and non-claim transaction regressions, including inventory, allowance, admissions, benefits and fulfillment.

B01–B16 and §4 distinguish body transport from malformed receipts, native completion from API fulfillment, stale identity from current results, client deadlines from server ownership, and typed absence from generic 404/READY/unsupported statuses. Holds, budgets and uncertain ownership stop unsafe continuation.

I0–I6 each provide three verifiable criteria, dependencies, affected callers and explicit acceptance gates. The fault crosswalk covers the preserved brief; transaction remedy precedes financial guarantees, and durable catch-up remains necessary before full task completion. No RED/GREEN or live acceptance is fabricated.

Sections 3, 5–7 retain timing, budgets, retention, catch-up mechanism and operational authority as unresolved gates. Original-spec and routing preserve the governing commerce plan, final deployment milestone and separate execution/provider/dependency/runtime approvals.

Current behavior and proposals are explicitly separated. Admission cannot silently expire into concurrent work; nested-lock deadlock and stale-owner fencing require proof. Candidate identity remained stable through the final hash check. Reviewer agreement does not confer owner acceptance or registry authority.

suggestions: In reconciliation-design.md §6, I3 criterion 2, qualify the shorthand prohibition on auto-release as prohibiting new or speculative release rules; §3 already correctly preserves the existing evidence-backed full-cancellation release path.
scope_attestation: Read-only independent design review. No other reviewer assessment was accessed or requested. No writes, app imports/execution, tests, builds, browser/services, DB/provider/network calls, environment/credential inspection, hardware checks, installs or subagents. Source/semantic design quality only; not owner, runtime, provider, device or production acceptance.
